svg.title: Example: Opportunity Solution Tree
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape opportunity solution tree: outcome, three opportunities with two solutions each, riskiest assumptions and tests, an assumption map, and an assumption test table.
svg.text: Connect a product outcome to customer opportunities, candidate solutions, and the assumptions to test first.
